skill.name: recoup-platform-api-access
skill.description: Access Recoup resources, research data, connector catalogs, and authorized external services through documented API workflows.
skill.summary: Retrieve Recoup data and perform approved connector actions with authenticated API requests.
skill.author: recoupable

security_audit.summary: All 52 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, declared Recoup URLs, or scoped credential use over HTTPS. One high-severity semantic issue remains because external writes and email sends lack a mandatory confirmation gate.

remediation.issue: External write actions lack a mandatory confirmation step.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation immediately before each connector write, email send, or social post. Show the destination and payload summary first.

remediation.issue: Email recipient validation occurs after transmission.
remediation.suggestion: Validate recipient arrays and display resolved recipients before sending. Abort when fields are unknown or recipients differ from the user request.

content.user_title: Access Recoup Platform Data and Connectors
content.value_statement: Recoup data and connected services require precise authentication, identifiers, and endpoint schemas. This skill guides reliable retrieval and approved external actions.
actual_capabilities: Authenticates Recoup API calls with an available API key or access token.
Retrieves account, artist, roster, social, research, and connector information.
Scrapes supported public social profiles through Recoup endpoints.
Discovers connector actions and their current parameter schemas.
Executes connected Google, Gmail, TikTok, and Instagram actions.
Sends Recoup emails and verifies the returned recipient message.
limitations: Valid Recoup credentials are required for authenticated requests.
Data availability depends on account access, connected services, and supported sources.
External write actions can change documents, send messages, or publish content.
Roster onboarding and artist operations require separate Recoup skills.

use_cases.title: Review an artist roster
use_cases.description: Verify the account, list roster artists, and retrieve available social metrics without inventing missing data.

use_cases.title: Research artist opportunities
use_cases.description: Query Recoup research resources for audience geography, similar artists, and available public profile data.

use_cases.title: Deliver operational updates
use_cases.description: Inspect connector schemas before updating approved documents, spreadsheets, or email reports.

prompt_templates.title: Check my roster
prompt_templates.prompt: Using Recoup, verify my account and list roster artists. Report only returned names and account identifiers. Do not modify anything.

prompt_templates.title: Research an artist
prompt_templates.prompt: Research {artist} through Recoup. Return available audience geography, similar artists, and public social metrics. Clearly identify missing sources.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a connector action
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the connector action for updating this Google Sheet: {url}. Show connection status and required parameters. Do not execute it yet.

prompt_templates.title: Run an approved reporting workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: After I confirm, scrape current metrics for {artist}, summarize changes, update {document_url}, and email {recipients}. Verify every action result.

output_examples.input: Verify my account and list the artists on my roster.
output_examples.output: Account verified. The roster artists are listed with their account identifiers. No external changes were made.

output_examples.input: Find similar artists and audience geography for the selected artist.
output_examples.output: The report includes retrieved similar artists and available audience regions. Missing sources are identified without estimates.

output_examples.input: Prepare to update my campaign sheet with current social metrics.
output_examples.output: The connector is available. The required fields and proposed row changes are ready for confirmation before execution.

best_practices: Resolve roster artists with account identifiers before requesting artist subresources.
Retrieve the current connector parameter schema before every external action.
Confirm destinations and payload summaries before document edits, messages, or social posts.
anti_patterns: Do not invent artists, metrics, endpoint paths, or placeholder values.
Do not retry missing or expired credentials without requesting authentication.
Do not execute external write actions from ambiguous requests or unverified targets.

faq.question: What credentials does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a Recoup API key or Recoup access token supplied through the supported environment variables.

faq.question: Can it access artists outside my roster?
faq.answer: It can use research endpoints for any artist. Roster-specific resources require access through your Recoup account.

faq.question: Which external services are supported?
faq.answer: The connector catalog can expose authorized Google Workspace, Gmail, TikTok, Instagram, and other available integrations.

faq.question: Does it create missing analytics?
faq.answer: No. It reports retrieved values and identifies unavailable sources without estimates or placeholder metrics.

faq.question: Can it send email?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use Recoup email delivery or an authorized Gmail connector after recipients and content are confirmed.

faq.question: How does it handle API errors?
faq.answer: It reports authentication and access errors, checks endpoint documentation, and retries server errors once before stopping.
